claims.content: The C2 JU manages and applies transmit filters to determine which surveillance tracks are eligible for transmission on the interface.

goal.raw_text: The C2 JU manages and applies transmit filters to determine which surveillance tracks are eligible for transmission on the interface.

claims.content: C2 JU
The use of interface filters must be coordinated with all participating Information Units (IUs) to minimize track management problems.
Transmit filters must be identified by a filter number for coordination purposes.
The C2 JU coordinates the use of interface filters with all participating Information Units (IUs) to minimize track management problems, potentially using voice or other communications media.
Transmit filters are identified by a filter number for coordination purposes with other JUs.
When a receive filter is established, the C2 JU establishes a corresponding transmit filter which duplicates the receive filter.

The C2 JU manages and applies transmit filters to determine which surveillance tracks are eligible for transmission; tracks are eligible only if not inhibited by any currently set transmission filters.

Upon activation of a transmit filter, the unit ceases reporting any track for which it has R² that meets the filter criteria and complies with rules for terminating transmission of applicable track data.
Management and reporting of Link 16 transmit filters are accomplished using J7.6 messages (Filter Implementation Request, Filter Description Report, Delete Filter Request/Report) and J7.1 messages.
A special processing filter allows a JU to filter data based on the setting of the Special Processing Indicator field.
A simulation filter allows a JU to filter data and IUs based on the setting of the Simulation Indicator field.
The J7.6 (ACT = 2) message is used by a JU to request that a filter or all filters be deleted by an addressed JU, or to report deletion of one or all of its filters.
When a JU deletes a filter which it had reported, it should transmit a J7.6 (ACT = 2) message; remote filters shall be dropped when such a message is received.
Filter messages are nonredundant, and each JU should have the capability to drop remote filter reports from its own system.
The J7.1 (ACT = 0) message may be used by a JU to request information on a specific filter or all locally inserted filters.

Upon activation of a transmit filter, the unit ceases reporting any track for which it has R² that meets the filter criteria and complies with rules for terminating transmission of applicable track data.
Filters apply to tracks initiated prior to filter activation as well as to tracks initiated while the filter is active.
Tracks are eligible for transmission on the interface only if they are not inhibited from transmission by any of the transmission filters currently set.
Management and reporting of Link 16 transmit filters are accomplished using J7.6 messages (Filter Implementation Request, Filter Description Report, Delete Filter Request/Report) and J7.1 messages.
Transmit filters requested or reported in the J7.6 message apply to four classes of data: Tracks, Reference Points, Electronic Warfare Product Information, and Targets.
The J7.2 Correlation message shall not be inhibited by any filter.
